title: Couverture sinistre — Contrats
description: Comment chaque contrat a été lu. Source : tables `contrats` et `clauses`.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS contrats FROM contrats
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS contrats FROM contrats

panels.title: À vérifier
panels.description: Contrats mal lus selon les contrôles du découpage : un profil d'assureur corrige.

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS a_verifier FROM contrats WHERE statut != 'OK'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS a_verifier FROM contrats WHERE statut != 'OK'

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS clauses FROM clauses
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS clauses FROM clauses

targets.queryText:
SELECT id AS contrat, assureur, produit, version, statut,
       json_extract(rapport, '$.nb_clauses') AS clauses,
       json_array_length(json_extract(rapport, '$.alertes')) AS alertes,
       ingere_le
FROM contrats ORDER BY statut DESC, id
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT id AS contrat, assureur, produit, version, statut,
       json_extract(rapport, '$.nb_clauses') AS clauses,
       json_array_length(json_extract(rapport, '$.alertes')) AS alertes,
       ingere_le
FROM contrats ORDER BY statut DESC, id

panels.title: Clauses par type
panels.description: Un contrat sans exclusion, ou avec beaucoup de clauses sans type, a été mal lu.

targets.queryText:
SELECT contrat_id AS contrat,
       SUM(type = 'garantie') AS garanties, SUM(type = 'exclusion') AS exclusions,
       SUM(type = 'condition') AS conditions, SUM(type = 'limite') AS limites,
       SUM(type = 'definition') AS definitions, SUM(type = 'autre') AS sans_type
FROM clauses GROUP BY contrat_id ORDER BY contrat_id
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT contrat_id AS contrat,
       SUM(type = 'garantie') AS garanties, SUM(type = 'exclusion') AS exclusions,
       SUM(type = 'condition') AS conditions, SUM(type = 'limite') AS limites,
       SUM(type = 'definition') AS definitions, SUM(type = 'autre') AS sans_type
FROM clauses GROUP BY contrat_id ORDER BY contrat_id

targets.queryText:
SELECT c.id AS contrat, a.value AS alerte
FROM contrats AS c, json_each(json_extract(c.rapport, '$.alertes')) AS a
ORDER BY c.id
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT c.id AS contrat, a.value AS alerte
FROM contrats AS c, json_each(json_extract(c.rapport, '$.alertes')) AS a
ORDER BY c.id
